title: PDV Phase 12 contextual favor and Nord breadth pilot contract
notes: Phase 12 is a favor-first phase, not UI toast hardening and not generic CKPE bridge expansion.
The first live runtime tranche is focused Kyne plus the two Nord broad-worship lanes.
The one-active contextual-favor cap is global. While a favor is active, new favor triggers are suppressed. This phase does not replace or refresh an already-active favor in place.
Runtime ownership is hybrid split: PDV__ManagerQuest owns orchestration, while shared StorageUtil keys, family keywords, and stable favor record naming carry the effect-holder contract.
The Phase 12 helper can create the missing Phase 12 KYWD, MGEF, and SPEL records when invoked with --create-missing. Generic record creation outside this manifest remains out of scope.

Runtime proof passed on 2026-05-26: all 14 positive family activations passed, active-favor suppression passed, non-Nord broad-lane block passed, and save/load persistence passed for both active and expired favor states.

rules: every required spell and magic effect record exists
the Nord pantheon baseline track is wired and labeled for OldWays and NineDivines
focused Kyne exposes exactly 4 trigger families
each Nord broad lane exposes exactly 5 trigger families
broad Nord lanes remain capped at Faithful or Tier 2 semantics
the manager source contains the one-active cap, expiry, and per-lane last-trigger storage contract

positive: Kyne Champion can trigger all 4 focused Kyne favor families
Nord broad Old Ways can trigger all 5 broad-lane families while broad worship is active and baseline is OldWays
Nord broad Nine Divines can trigger all 5 broad-lane families while broad worship is active and baseline is NineDivines
negative: wrong active deity does not trigger focused Kyne favors
Kyne below Champion does not trigger focused Kyne favors
non-Nord does not trigger Nord broad lanes
active primary patron suppresses broad Nord favor activation
an active favor suppresses a second favor trigger until expiry
persistence: expired favor clears after load and does not remain stuck on the player
proofSummary: Focused Kyne runtime proof passed for Open-sky rest recovery, Storm-road grace, Guided hunt, and Wind-marked passage.
Broad Old Ways runtime proof passed for Sky-road endurance, Honorable ordeal, Hearth and hold defense, Death-right and ancestor quiet, and Hidden Talos defiance.
Broad Nine Divines runtime proof passed for Kynareth's road grace, Household and mercy duty, Proper death and anti-necromancy, Honest work and learned craft, and Talos pressure inside the Nine.
Active favor suppression passed: a second trigger attempt did not replace an already-active favor.
Non-Nord block passed on a fresh Breton character: Nord broad-lane trigger attempt remained inactive.
Persistence passed: active favor survived save/load and expired favor stayed cleared after save/load.
